# llms.txt — Agent Achievement Badge

Agent Achievement Badge: free soulbound achievement badges for Agent ID
(.ai) holders on BNB Smart Chain. One badge per wallet per quest; third
party attestations for portable reputation. No owner, no fees, no
approvals. Users act through their own agent + Binance Agentic Wallet
(baw): preview -> user confirms -> execute.

## Docs

- skill: agent-facing instructions (preflight, read calls, claimBadge flow)
- contract: hackathon/contracts/src/AgentBadge.sol (open source, verified on BscScan at deploy)
- registry: 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F (SPACE ID Agent ID, immutable ref)

## Contract

- Chain: BNB Smart Chain mainnet (chainId 56)
- Address: <CONTRACT_ADDRESS> (filled after mainnet deploy)
- Functions: claimBadge(uint256 questId), attest(uint256 badgeId, string note),
  view: totalBadges(), uniqueAgents(), questClaimCount(uint256),
  attestationCount(uint256), handleOfBadgeOwner(uint256)

## Quests

- questId=1: Hackathon Participation (open)

## Compliance

- No Binance/BNB branding; no promised returns; no approvals; no custodial
  sessions; every asset action confirmed by the user in their wallet.
